documentCompare.guide.title: Usage Guide
documentCompare.guide.description: Compare Word and Hangul (HWP) documents before and after revisions to check for changes in text, tables, and formatting.

blocks.title: Use Cases
items: Finding changes in a revised report
Comparing multiple drafts against the original
Checking for missing or added document content.

blocks.title: How to Use
items: Add the pre-revision and post-revision files respectively.
Check the file mapping and order for comparison.
Run the comparison.
Review the original and revised versions along with the list of changes on the result screen.
Save the desired results.

blocks.title: Results and Precautions
paragraphs: Read the original text alongside the change indicators to verify if it represents an actual meaning change. Indicators might appear due to internal structure or formatting differences. Automated handling may be difficult if similar types of content repeat.

faq.q: Can I use both Word and Hangul files?
faq.a: You can select and compare supported Word and Hangul files. Check the support guide in the selection area for openable formats and file-specific limitations.

security.guide.title: Password Generator Guide
security.guide.description: Created using the secure random number function provided by the operating system, and passwords are not sent to the server.

blocks.title: Long and Unique
paragraphs: It is recommended to use different passwords of at least 16 characters for each site and store them in a password manager.

blocks.title: Strength Score
paragraphs: Calculated based on estimated guess attempts and patterns like common words, repetitions, and sequential characters. It does not check for leaks or the multi-factor authentication status of the account.

blocks.title: Estimated Crack Time
paragraphs: A comparative value assuming a stored password hash is leaked and an attacker can attempt 10 billion guesses per second. Actual time varies greatly depending on the site's storage method and security settings.

faq.q: Are the generated passwords saved?
faq.a: No. They disappear once you leave the current screen.

faq.q: Does the estimated crack time mean actual security time?
faq.a: No. It is a hypothetical value to compare the strength between passwords. Actual attack conditions vary based on login attempt limits, password storage methods, and multi-factor authentication.

faq.q: Are copied passwords safe?
faq.a: Since other apps can access the clipboard, it is recommended to copy and overwrite it with something else after use.

formatter.guide.title: Formatter Usage Guide
formatter.guide.description: Entered text is processed only in the browser's separate workspace.

blocks.title: Error Checking
paragraphs: JSON and XML show the location where errors are found, and SQL arranges lines and indentation based on statement components.

blocks.title: Minify to One Line
paragraphs: Maintains text and spaces inside quotes, and only reduces unnecessary spaces and line breaks that are not required for the data structure.

faq.q: Does it execute SQL?
faq.a: No. It only formats text without a database connection.

faq.q: Does it auto-recover invalid JSON?
faq.a: To prevent data alteration, it shows the error without arbitrarily recovering it.

converter.guide.title: Table Data Conversion Guide
converter.guide.description: Files and text are processed in the browser's separate workspace.

blocks.title: CSV
paragraphs: Uses the first row as column names, and interprets cells with quotes, commas, and line breaks using standard CSV quote rules.

blocks.title: JSON / HTML
paragraphs: Gathers all keys from a JSON object array into columns, and HTML tables use the first row as headers.

faq.q: Are large CSV files supported?
faq.a: Processed as a separate task within the browser's memory limit. Hundreds of thousands of rows may take time depending on file size and device memory.

faq.q: Are scripts inside HTML executed?
faq.a: No. It only extracts text from table cells and does not insert or execute the input HTML on the screen.

textMerger.guide.title: Text Merger Usage Guide
textMerger.guide.description: Gathers manually entered text and TXT files into one list and merges them into a single text.

blocks.title: Use Cases
items: Consolidating multiple notes into one file
Inserting guide sentences between TXT files
Connecting separated lists in a specific order.

blocks.title: How to Use
items: Add manual input or TXT files.
Determine the order of the cards.
Choose the line break, space, or separator character to insert between each text.
Check the merged result and copy it or save it as a TXT file.

faq.q: Can I insert manually written sentences between files?
faq.a: Yes. You can place manual input cards and TXT file cards in any desired order within the same list.

textTools.guide.title: Text Tools Usage Guide
textTools.guide.description: Cleans up spaces, line breaks, and duplicate lines in pasted text according to the selected method.

blocks.title: Use Cases
items: When copied text has many unnecessary line breaks
Removing duplicate lines from a list
Standardizing the formatting of English names.

blocks.title: How to Use
items: Paste the original text.
Choose the necessary actions, such as space cleanup or line break merging.
Compare the result with the original text.
Copy and use the result.

faq.q: Does it also fix the content or meaning of the text?
faq.a: Space and line cleanup applies selected rules. It is not a feature that understands the meaning and rewrites sentences.

work.guide.title: Working Day Calculation Criteria
work.guide.description: Public holiday information and annual leave results are reference values for schedule planning.

blocks.title: Public Holidays
paragraphs: Calculates solar public holidays, Seollal, Chuseok, Buddha's Birthday, and substitute holidays. Fixed election days and temporary holidays are also reflected in the yearly list. Please manually add company holidays.

blocks.title: Annual Leave
paragraphs: Applies the basic accrual structure under the Labor Standards Act, but the actual granted days may vary depending on the company's fiscal year operation and time-and-attendance settlement methods.

faq.q: Are temporary holidays automatically reflected?
faq.a: Confirmed public holidays reflected in the yearly list are automatically calculated. If recent government announcements are not yet reflected, or if it's a company-specific day off, please add it manually.

faq.q: Is the final leave settlement upon resignation identical?
faq.a: No. Resignation settlements require checking both the accrued leave based on the joining date and the number of days used at the company.

payroll.guide.title: Simple Payroll Calculator Guide
payroll.guide.description: Does not replace actual payslips and statutory settlements.

blocks.title: Net Pay
paragraphs: Estimates social insurance and monthly income tax based on the monthly taxable salary (excluding non-taxable allowances like meals) and the number of dependents. It may vary depending on the company's reported standard monthly income, non-taxable items, and withholding rates.

blocks.title: Severance Pay
paragraphs: Reflects the wages of the 3 months before retirement and 3/12 of the recent year's bonuses and annual leave allowances. The total number of days for 3 months includes calendar dates including holidays. Separate verification is needed if the calculated average wage is lower than the ordinary wage.

faq.q: Is the entered salary saved?
faq.a: No. All values are calculated only in the current screen state and browser memory.

faq.q: Can I use it for tax reporting?
faq.a: No. It is an estimated value for reference, and actual withholding and severance pay should be verified with the company's payroll manager or relevant authorities.

qr.guide.title: QR Code Usage Guide
qr.guide.description: Generated content, camera frames, and scanned images are not sent to external servers.

blocks.title: Center Logo
paragraphs: Uses a high error correction level and adds a white margin behind the logo. If the logo is too complex, the recognition rate may drop on some cameras.

blocks.title: Real-time Camera
paragraphs: Prioritizes the rear camera after obtaining user permission over a secure connection (HTTPS). When a QR is found, it immediately stops the camera and analysis operations.

blocks.title: Photo Scan
paragraphs: Large images are downscaled to a maximum of 2200px within the browser, and it also attempts to find the QR by inverting bright and dark colors.

faq.q: Does it also check the safety of the QR URL?
faq.a: No. It merely displays the QR data and does not guarantee the safety of the linked site.

faq.q: When is the camera permission used?
faq.a: Permission is requested only when the scan via camera button is pressed. The camera track is immediately stopped upon scan completion, turning off the camera, switching tabs, or closing the page.

timezone.guide.title: World Time Zone Map Usage Guide
timezone.guide.description: The map and city coordinates are included in the site, and selection information is not transmitted outside the browser.

blocks.title: Map and City Selection
paragraphs: You can select up to 6 cities using pins or city search. After zooming in, drag the map to check pins in dense areas.

blocks.title: Daylight Saving Time (DST)
paragraphs: Cities like New York, London, and Sydney have different transition dates. The time difference with UTC is calculated using the International standard city time zone (IANA) rules for the selected date.

blocks.title: Meeting Recommendations
paragraphs: Displays only the intervals (in 30-minute increments) where all selected cities are within their local 09:00~18:00.

faq.q: Does it connect to an external map server while using the map?
faq.a: No. The Natural Earth-based world map and city coordinates are distributed together as static assets.

faq.q: Can I tap anywhere on the map to find a time zone?
faq.a: No. Currently, you can only select major city pins registered with official time zone information and search results.

faq.q: Are public holidays reflected?
faq.a: This tool only compares time differences and local business hours, and does not reflect country-specific public holidays.

excel.guide.title: Excel Merger Usage Guide
excel.guide.description: Gathers multiple Excel files by sheet, or concatenates tables downwards or sideways.

blocks.title: Use Cases
items: Consolidating departmental data into one file
Merging monthly lists vertically
Attaching divided tables in a specific direction.

blocks.title: What to Prepare
paragraphs: Excel or CSV files to merge and the sheets to include.

blocks.title: How to Use
items: Add files and select the sheets to merge.
Check the order of files and sheets that will be in the result.
Choose a merging method. 'By Sheet' collects sheets, 'Vertical' appends downwards, and 'Horizontal' appends sideways.
Review options to maintain formulas and formatting, and the support guide on the screen, before merging.
Open the result and check if the number of sheets, rows, and column positions are as expected.

blocks.title: Results and Precautions
paragraphs: Creates a new XLSX file. Features beyond macros and the supported range may not be maintained, so keep the original. Do not confuse horizontal merging with features that automatically link data based on criteria like customer ID.

faq.q: Which should I choose among By Sheet, Vertical, and Horizontal?
faq.a: To keep each sheet separate and gather them in one file, choose By Sheet. To expand lists with the same structure downwards, choose Vertical. To attach tables to the side, choose Horizontal.

faq.q: Does horizontal merging automatically align the same customers?
faq.a: Horizontal merging is a method of attaching tables sideways. If you need to align based on the same customer or employee ID, check the row order first. If your goal is to check the differences between two lists, consider the Key Column Comparison in Excel Compare.

audio.guide.title: Audio Waveform Editing Guide
audio.guide.description: Selected audio and editing data are not transmitted to an external server and are processed only within the current browser.

blocks.title: Waveform Selection
paragraphs: Dragging the waveform creates a purple selection area. You can move the entire area, adjust the handles on both sides, and specify values down to 1ms by entering the start and end seconds.

blocks.title: Sample-level Editing
paragraphs: Mute changes selected samples to 0, and Cut and Delete pull trailing samples forward. Paste inserts the memory clip at the current red playback cursor position.

blocks.title: Voice Effects for Selected Section
paragraphs: Low Pitch, High Pitch, and Child Voice change the pitch while maintaining the original length, and Robot rapidly modulates the amplitude. You can preview the selected section before applying, and short crossfades are added at the boundaries.

blocks.title: Keyboard Shortcuts
paragraphs: Outside input fields, use Space to Play/Pause, and Ctrl+Z or Cmd+Z (on macOS) to Undo. Ctrl+Shift+Z, Cmd+Shift+Z, Ctrl+Y, or Cmd+Y are for Redo.

blocks.title: Undo and Memory
paragraphs: Uncompressed voice samples (PCM) for editing are kept per channel. The Undo history is automatically limited to a maximum of 12 steps and an approx. 256MB limit depending on file size, and is cleared when a new file is opened.

blocks.title: WAV and MP3
paragraphs: WAV creates highly compatible 16-bit uncompressed audio quickly. Audio processing features needed for MP3 saving and pitch effects are prepared on first use, reducing preparation time on the same editing screen.

blocks.title: Browser File Support
paragraphs: MP3 and WAV can be opened in general modern browsers. M4A, AAC, and OGG can be edited when the operating system and browser support the audio compression method in the file.

faq.q: Is audio uploaded to the server?
faq.a: No. Opening files, editing samples, waveform previews, and resulting conversions are executed solely in the current browser.

faq.q: Do low pitch and high pitch change gender?
faq.a: No. It is an effect that changes only the pitch and timbre of the selected section without determining or changing a person's gender.

faq.q: Where does Paste get inserted?
faq.a: It gets inserted at the current time of the red playback cursor, positioned by clicking or playing the waveform.

faq.q: Why do long files use a lot of memory?
faq.a: Because even compressed audio must be decompressed into uncompressed samples per channel for editing, and waveform playback data and Undo states are also kept.

faq.q: Is MP3 created immediately offline?
faq.a: It might be possible if the encoder was cached previously. For your first visit in a completely offline state, please use WAV.

faq.q: Do editing results overwrite the original?
faq.a: No. The original file is not modified, and you download a new WAV or MP3 file.

image.guide.title: Browser Image Editing Guide
image.guide.description: Original images and editing results are not uploaded to external processing servers.

blocks.title: Integrated Image Editing
paragraphs: Open a photo or start with a blank canvas to use adjustments, drawing, text, shapes, and searchable stickers within one work history. You can change the entire content or canvas size separately and specify the export pixel size. Zoom in with the mouse wheel, drag while pressing Space to move, and use two fingers to zoom and move on mobile.

blocks.title: Area Mosaic / Blur
paragraphs: You can drag areas to obscure in the photo and adjust the effect intensity. The effect applies based on the original photo, so if areas overlap, the last effect is visible. It does not apply to separately drawn lines or text. For sensitive information, a strong mosaic is recommended over a low-intensity blur. Before downloading, zoom in to check the obscured state.

blocks.title: Batch Processing
paragraphs: Add multiple files and clipboard images to apply resizing and watermarks, and bundle them into a ZIP.

blocks.title: Collage and GIF
paragraphs: Provides downscaled previews equal to the actual output calculation, and GIFs may have simplified color changes due to the 256-color limit.

faq.q: Are images sent to the server?
faq.a: No. They are processed only within the current browser.

faq.q: Is the original file changed?
faq.a: No. All results are downloaded as new files.

faq.q: Can I recover contents obscured by mosaic or blur?
faq.a: For downloaded PNG, JPG, or WebP files, the effects are embedded into the original photo pixels, leaving no previous pixels of the obscured areas. However, during the editing session before downloading, you can revert to the pre-effect state using Undo.

faq.q: What formats are supported?
faq.a: Inputs are JPG, PNG, and WebP; HEIC and HEIF are not supported. Outputs are PNG, JPG, WebP, and GIF.

faq.q: Can I keep the transparent background?
faq.a: PNG and WebP maintain transparency, whereas JPG treats it as white.

faq.q: Why does processing large images stop?
faq.a: Due to browser and device canvas/memory limits. Please reduce the output size or the number of files.

excelCompare.guide.title: Excel Compare Usage Guide
excelCompare.guide.description: Pairs two Excel files to find changed contents or mismatched items.

blocks.title: Use Cases
items: Comparing data before and after revisions
Matching two lists by employee ID or order number
Checking transactions where amounts, dates, and vendors match.

blocks.title: What to Prepare
paragraphs: The left and right files to compare. Identify the row with column names and the key columns beforehand.

blocks.title: How to Use
items: Add two files to compare as a pair. To compare multiple pairs, add more file pairs.
Check the sheet to use and the row with column names in each file. If there is a title or description above, change it to the actual row containing column names.
Select a comparison method suitable for your purpose.
Run the comparison and check for changes, additions, deletions, and duplicates in the result filters.
Save necessary reports. For items that could not be linked automatically, review the original files.

blocks.title: Easy to Understand Example
paragraphs: For an employee list where the order of names has changed, it is better to compare based on unique employee IDs rather than names. A 'Key' refers to this kind of reference column used to find the same target.

faq.q: Which comparison method should I choose?
faq.a: To check pre/post revisions of similar tables, select Row/Column Matching. To find the same targets in lists with different orders, select Key Column Comparison. To match transaction amounts and dates, select Transaction Matching.

excelCleaner.guide.title: Excel Data Cleaner Usage Guide
excelCleaner.guide.description: Applies necessary cleaning rules in order to Excel data and creates a new file and processing report.

blocks.title: Use Cases
items: Formatting or fixing spaces in lists received from outside
Cleaning up unnecessary rows and columns
Performing repetitive data cleanup in the same order.

blocks.title: How to Use
items: Add a file and select the sheet to clean and the row with column names.
Add necessary rules. It is good to start with one rule to check the result first.
Rules run from top to bottom. Check the order and settings of each rule.
Review information about formulas, merged cells, and output formats, then run.
Check the cleaned data as well as the change summary, errors, and excluded rows.

blocks.title: Example
paragraphs: If data looks different due to leading/trailing spaces like `Seoul` and ` Seoul `, apply Space Cleanup first, and then decide whether to apply Duplicate Cleanup. The result may vary depending on the rule order.

faq.q: Which rule should I pick first?
faq.a: Pick one problem you want to solve. For example, if spacing is an issue, apply Space Cleanup first, and then add rules for duplicates or row deletion.

documentRedactor.guide.title: Document Redactor Usage Guide
documentRedactor.guide.description: Creates a new file by manually selecting and blacking out parts like names, phone numbers, and addresses in PDFs or images.

blocks.title: Use Cases
items: Obscuring some information before sending evidence externally
Redacting contacts or account numbers in receipts or contracts
Covering text that shouldn't be revealed in captures.

blocks.title: How to Use
items: Add a file and select the document and pages to redact.
Press 'Add Area' to create a black rectangle. Adjust its position and size so no text is left. Move to the next page and check all necessary parts.
Check the 'Pages without redacted marks' list. No marks does not mean it is automatically determined to be safe.
Read about the output resolution and what changes upon output, check the confirmation items, and press 'Create Redacted File'.
Check 'View Results' and re-open the downloaded file to verify all pages. Share the resulting file, not the original.

blocks.title: Good to Know
paragraphs: This tool does not automatically find personal information. The user must manually select the areas to redact. Information may remain in the file name or unredacted pages.

faq.q: Does it automatically detect and redact personal information like ID or phone numbers?
faq.a: No. You must review the pages yourself and specify the areas to redact. Unmarked areas will remain visible in the result.

faq.q: Is the original file modified?
faq.a: The original file is not modified and remains safely on your device. Please ensure you share the newly saved result.

faq.q: Are unredacted pages also converted to images?
faq.a: Yes. To ensure the entire document is securely processed, all pages are recreated as an image-based PDF.

faq.q: Are search and links retained in the document?
faq.a: Because the document is converted to images, text search, selection, copying, existing links, signatures, forms, and metadata are not retained.

faq.q: What is the resolution of the output?
faq.a: The document is converted according to the quality option you select (Standard or High Quality).

faq.q: Are password-protected PDFs supported?
faq.a: Password-protected or encrypted PDFs are not supported. Please use an unprotected copy.

faq.q: What happens if I cancel or if it fails?
faq.a: If the operation is interrupted, the files are immediately discarded and never leave your device.

faq.q: What should I check in the final result?
faq.a: Please review all pages, ensure text edges are fully redacted, and check that the filename does not contain personal information.

documentRedactor.guide.fallbackNotice: The file processing engine could not be initialized in the current environment. File selection is disabled, but you can view the usage guide and precautions below.

faq.q: What happens if there are blanks?
faq.a: If the value in a linked column is empty, that space may become empty content. If the required column itself is not linked, that's a different issue and the connection must be fixed. Make sure required values are not missing in the sample. Completely blank rows are excluded from generation.

faq.q: Does this feature automatically send emails?
faq.a: No. It is a feature for creating document files. It's known as 'Mail Merge', but it does not send emails.

documentGenerator.guide.title: Word Batch Generator Usage Guide
documentGenerator.guide.description: Insert a Word template and an Excel list to generate documents per person or per item at once.

blocks.title: Use Cases
items: Creating training guides per employee
Generating confirmation documents for each customer
Creating multiple documents where only name, department, and date change in the same template.

blocks.title: How to Use
items: Link Excel columns with template items. If you wrote `{Name}` in the template, link it to the column containing name data.
Set the file name and check one document first. Specify file naming rules, verify them, and run 'Create 1 Document First'.
Generate all documents and save the results.

blocks.title: What This Tool Does
paragraphs: It is not an AI tool that writes new text. It inserts Excel values into the changeable parts of a pre-made Word template.
